npcs.name: Falion
npcs.greet: Morthal has little use for a conjurer, and less for questions. Still, you have the look of someone who needs one.

falion_ritual: At the summoning circle the marsh mist turns gold with the first light. Falion raises the black soul gem, and it drinks.
Hold still. The thing in your blood is leaving, and it does not go quietly.
Cold rushes through you, then warmth: the sun on your face, and nothing in it but light.

quests.title: Rising at Dawn
quests.offer: I've heard you know a cure for vampirism.
quests.pitch: I do, and I'll not ask how you came by the need. Bring me a black soul gem, then meet me at the summoning circle outside town at dawn. The soul pays for the ritual, not you.
quests.desc: Falion, the wizard of Morthal, can cure my vampirism with an old ritual. He needs a black soul gem, and the ritual must be done at dawn at the summoning circle outside Morthal.

objectives.text: Bring Falion a black soul gem
objectives.topic: I have the black soul gem.
objectives.reply: Good. Go to the summoning circle east of town and wait for first light. I'll be there before you.

objectives.text: Go to the summoning circle outside Morthal
Wait for dawn at the summoning circle

objectives.reply: Then kneel in the circle, and let the sun see you.
